mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuthorizationRules disconnects the outcome of every AccessOp from the permission logic, so Alloy can freely assign Permitted to any (role, operation) pair, violating all access-control assertions at once.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthViolation { some op: AccessOp | op.opCaller.role = ComplianceOfficer and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AppendOnlyAuditEntries allows two AuditEntries to share the same AccessOp, which models overwriting an existing audit entry — exactly the mutation the AppendOnly invariant forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.logOp = ae2.logOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditCompleteness allows an AccessOp to exist without a matching AuditEntry, so a permitted record read or note append could occur with no audit trail — the core SC-002 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: AccessOp | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.logOp = op }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_ComplianceContentBlind allows Alloy to assign Permitted to a ComplianceOfficer calling GetRecord, directly violating the HIPAA content-blindness invariant for compliance officers.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ComplianceLeaks { some op: AccessOp | op.opCaller.role = ComplianceOfficer and op.opKind = GetRecord and op.opOutcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_AuditEntryAttribution allows an AuditEntry's snapshotted role or outcome to differ from the actual operation, so a denied access could be recorded as permitted or attributed to the wrong role.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionWrong { some ae: AuditEntry | ae.logOutcome != ae.logOp.opOutcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing F_PatientRecordPairing allows a Patient to have no assigned record or multiple assigned records, breaking the ownership-based access check that gates patient self-access.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientPairingBroken { some u: User | u.role = Patient and no u.assignedRecord }
